settings_db_companion_desc: The Companion keeps recent Zotero changes available to ZotLit.
settings_db_stale_help_desc: Follow the troubleshooting guide to make recent changes available to ZotLit.
settings_db_profile_dir_desc: Determines where ZotLit reads your Zotero library.
settings_db_device_override_note: Stored on this device only. It doesn't sync to your other devices.
settings_db_read_mode_desc: While Zotero is running, it holds the database file open. This setting controls how ZotLit reads it without interfering. Auto picks the best available method.
settings_db_read_mode_reflink_desc: Fast, lightweight snapshot: sees recent edits
settings_db_read_mode_copy_desc: Full database copy: sees recent edits, but slower and uses more disk space
settings_db_read_mode_immutable_desc: Reads the database directly: recent edits may not appear immediately
settings_db_auto_refresh_desc: Reload automatically when `zotero.sqlite` changes on disk.
settings_db_data_dir_desc: Override where ZotLit reads `zotero.sqlite`. Use only when Zotero runs on a non-default profile.
settings_db_source_id_desc: Live updates are accepted only from a Zotero install whose profile and data directory match these.
settings_library_scope_desc: Libraries used for item search, citation key resolution, and library-wide commands.
settings_library_scope_invalid: The saved library scope is invalid. ZotLit is using My Library until you select a library scope here.
settings_library_scope_db_unavailable: Open the Zotero database to edit the library scope.
annot_view_empty: Open a literature note to see annotations.
annot_view_empty_reader: Open an item in the Zotero reader to see its annotations.
annot_view_follow_reader_disabled_toolti: Enable live updates in settings to follow the Zotero reader
annot_view_drag_no_note_tooltip: Open a note to drag annotations into it
annot_view_drag_unavailable: Cannot insert the annotation: the template is not ready.
annot_view_filter_no_match: No annotations match the current filters
annot_view_copy_citation_no_key: This item has no citation key; nothing to copy
settings_page_frontmatter_desc: Map YAML properties added to every literature note.
settings_page_database_desc: Connect ZotLit to your Zotero library.
settings_page_library_desc: Choose which Zotero libraries ZotLit uses for search, citation keys, and library-wide commands.
settings_page_citations_desc: Configure citation suggestions, the citation index, and citation keys in the editor.
settings_page_templates_desc: Customize how notes, annotations, and citations render.
settings_page_attachments_desc: Import annotation images and attachments into the vault.
settings_page_note_import_desc: Configure how notes from Zotero are imported into the vault.
settings_page_maintenance_desc: Logging, recovery tools, and release-update notices.
settings_note_folder_desc: Where new literature notes are created.
settings_note_import_folder_desc: Where notes imported from Zotero are saved.
settings_note_import_colored_highlights_: Use color mappings to convert imported highlights to emoji-based syntax or HTML marks.
settings_note_import_highlight_mappings_: Choose HTML marks or an emoji for each Zotero highlight color.
settings_note_import_custom_emoji_invali: Enter one emoji. Incomplete mappings use HTML marks.
settings_note_import_annotations_templat: Render annotation paragraphs in imported notes with the annotation template, sourced from Zotero. In-place edits to those paragraphs in Zotero will be discarded.
settings_citation_suggester_desc: Suggest Zotero items while typing `[@` in the editor.
settings_citation_at_trigger_desc: Also open the suggester on a bare `@` at a word boundary. The query ends at the first space; type `_` where the search needs a space.
settings_citation_show_citekey_desc: Show each item's citation key beside its title in the suggester.
settings_citation_pandoc_citations_desc: Include Pandoc citations such as `@doe2024` in the references sidebar and ZotLit’s in-text features. This setting does not change citation insertion or export.
settings_citation_wikilink_citations_des: Include unaliased links to literature notes in the references sidebar and ZotLit’s in-text features. Heading links, block links, and invalid citation fragments stay as links. This setting does not change export.
settings_citation_show_formatted_desc: Show citations in Live Preview and reading view with the selected citation and references style. Source mode always shows Markdown. Citations stay unchanged when ZotLit cannot format them.
settings_citation_open_as_links_desc: Open literature notes when you select a Pandoc citation or a literature note wikilink shown as a citation. When off, selecting a citation places the cursor in the citation text so you can edit it.
settings_citation_hover_action_desc: What hovering a citation or literature note link shows. Page preview follows the Page preview plugin settings.
settings_citation_hover_mod_desc: Show the popover only while holding Ctrl (Windows) or Command (macOS).
settings_citation_references_style_desc: CSL style used to format in-text citations and the references sidebar. Install and manage styles in Zotero.
settings_citation_references_style_warni: This style isn’t installed in Zotero. Install it in Zotero or select another style.
settings_citation_locale_desc: Sets the language for citation terms, dates, names, and sorting. Leave empty to use the language the selected style declares.
settings_citation_locale_invalid: Enter a language code such as en-US, de, or zh-CN.
settings_citation_engine_desc: Formats in-text citations, references, and exports. Installation applies to every vault on this device.
settings_citation_engine_status_absent: Not installed. References stay a plain list until you install it.
settings_citation_engine_status_installi: Downloading the engine. This takes a while.
settings_citation_engine_status_hash_mis: The download did not match the pinned checksum, so ZotLit discarded it. Try again.
settings_citation_pandoc_guide_desc: ZotLit reference for the native Pandoc workflow.
settings_citation_pandoc_tutorial_desc: Follow the complete workflow from Literature Note citations to built-in and native Pandoc export.
settings_citation_pandoc_files_desc: Save the version-matched filter and defaults file to one folder. Keep both files together.
settings_citation_pandoc_folder_title: Select a folder for Pandoc integration files
settings_citation_pandoc_replace_body: This replaces {files} and writes the complete pair. If the save fails, ZotLit restores the prior pair.

citation_presentation_style_desc: Sets the CSL style this note's citations and references use. Install and manage styles in Zotero.

settings_note_frontmatter_order_desc: Drag to reorder. New notes use this order; existing notes keep their current property order.
settings_note_frontmatter_system_zotero_: Always written. Identifies the Zotero item this note belongs to.
settings_note_frontmatter_reset_confirm_: Replace your frontmatter fields with the built-in default? Your changes will be lost.
settings_frontmatter_expr_desc: Expression evaluated over the item, e.g. `zt.title`.
settings_frontmatter_language_desc: Language the expression is written in.

settings_template_js_enable_desc: Turn on JavaScript templates to let Eta templates (.eta.md) run JavaScript code.
settings_template_js_confirm_body: Eta templates run JavaScript with the same access as ZotLit itself: they can read and modify your vault, connect to the internet, and on desktop, access your system. Only enable this if you trust every template file in your vault.
settings_template_reset_confirm_body: Replace '{name}' with the built-in default? Your changes will be lost.

settings_attachment_import_desc: Copy annotation images and embedded attachments into the vault.

settings_attachment_approved_desc: Add a folder here when Zotero uses linked attachments stored outside its storage folder, annotation cache, or configured base attachment folder. ZotLit can then copy imported attachments from that location; other sources are linked instead of copied.
settings_attachment_approved_policy_desc: Approval applies to future imports; re-import previously imported notes to copy attachments that were skipped.
settings_page_live_updates_desc: Receive live updates from Zotero as you read and annotate, and refresh Zotero data the moment it changes.
settings_live_updates_enabled_desc: Run a local listener so ZotLit Companion, the Zotero add-on, can signal reader activity and new database changes.
settings_live_updates_companion_desc: Under {section} in the Companion, turn on {label} to complete the connection.
settings_live_updates_port_desc: Set the Companion's {label} to http://127.0.0.1:<port> to connect it.
settings_live_updates_hostname_desc: Address the listener binds to. Keep on 127.0.0.1 unless you know you need network access.

notice_protocol_update_zotero: Update ZotLit Companion, the Zotero add-on, to use this version of ZotLit.

notice_language_pack_reset: Language packs removed. Restart Obsidian to apply.
companion_zotero_10_guidance: Install or update ZotLit Companion, the Zotero add-on, so ZotLit reads recent changes from Zotero 10.
settings_update_notices_desc: Show a notice linking to the release notes after ZotLit updates.
settings_language_pack_desc: Show ZotLit's interface in {language}. Installing downloads a language pack.
settings_citation_index_reset_desc: Clear the stored citation key scans and rebuild them from your vault. Use this when the references sidebar disagrees with what a note cites.
settings_citation_index_reset_confirm_bo: The stored scans are cleared and ZotLit reads your notes again. Nothing in your vault changes.
settings_language_pack_reset_desc: Remove downloaded language packs and forget whether they were offered before. Use this when translated text looks wrong or outdated.
settings_language_pack_reset_confirm_bod: Downloaded language packs are removed. ZotLit offers to install them again after a restart.
settings_resources_whats_new_desc: See what changed in this release.
settings_resources_docs_desc: Guides and reference for setting up and using ZotLit.

settings_resources_bug_report_desc: File a bug report with steps to reproduce and debug logs.
